forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: a080
+title: 'MTP iterator: prime the drafter after chunked prefill through MTPDrafterPrefillFeed.primedState'
+---
+## What
+^9xe94tr added `MTPDrafterPrefillFeed.primedState(finalSegment:segmentHidden:firstBonus:positionDeltas:)` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPDrafterPrefillFeed.swift): resume the drafter from the boundary the prefill chunks left, else cold-start it at the final segment. `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.primeDrafterState(after:promptTokens:cachePosition:)` + `resumeOrColdStart` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.swift) still do the same resume-or-cold-start themselves for the after-feed path.
+
+- [ ] Make `primeDrafterState(after:...)` call `feed.primedState(...)` and keep `resumeOrColdStart` only for the continuation path that has no feed (or route that through one shared helper too).
+- [ ] Keep the passthrough reasons the iterator logs today.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] MLXLMTests MTP suites pass unchanged.
+- [ ] Release `qwen38FourBitMTPGeneration`, `qwen38FourBitMTPSystemPromptCache` (edit turn ~123 tokens) and `qwen38FourBitMTPSampledGeneration` stay at their numbers.
+
+#mtp #refactor
\ No newline at end of file
